text:
Munster’s median asking rent sits at 13.92 €/m², up 5.4 % year‑on‑year and 30.9 % over the last five years, placing the city 11th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The premium over existing rents is 60 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing about 835.0 € per month.

The market remains tight: vacancy is only 1.1 %, listings stay on the market for an average of 21 days and 36 % are let within a week. Affordability is modest, with rent‑burden for two residents at 17.2 % of income.

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 14.54 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 14.03 and 14.93 €/m², implying a further 4.5 % rise.
